mentions.name: Lume
mentions.description: Pure Rust in-memory hybrid search engine that pairs vector search (using the Shivvr embedder) with a Roaring bitmap solution for document search. Very fast, and serving as a reference for composable agentic search while it looks for a home.
mentions.source_excerpt: Have also been working on Lume, a pure Rust hybrid search engine (uses Shivvr the embedder above for vector search). Stupid fast. In memory. Roaring bitmap solution for document search.
